shellCommands.command: ls -a && cat AGENTS.md package.json && find .agents -type f | head -50 && git ls-files | head -50
cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui

grep -n -i -A 30 "^## .*markdown-editor" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -70; cat tsconfig.json vite.config.ts; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json && grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json; ls node_modules/.bin | grep -c .; (npm view @gravity-ui/markdown-editor version peerDependencies 2>&1 | head -40)

npm install @gravity-ui/markdown-editor @gravity-ui/components @diplodoc/transform @diplodoc/cut-extension @diplodoc/file-extension @diplodoc/html-extension @diplodoc/tabs-extension @diplodoc/latex-extension @diplodoc/mermaid-extension @diplodoc/quote-link-extension @diplodoc/folding-headings-extension markdown-it@^13 highlight.js@^11.8.0 lowlight@^3 katex@^0.16.9 2>&1 | tail -15; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/

for v in $(npm view @gravity-ui/components@4 version 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}' | tr -d "'" | tail -12); do echo -n "$v: "; npm view @gravity-ui/components@$v peerDependencies.@gravity-ui/uikit 2>/dev/null; done

npm install @gravity-ui/markdown-editor @gravity-ui/components@4.23.1 @diplodoc/transform @diplodoc/cut-extension @diplodoc/file-extension @diplodoc/html-extension @diplodoc/tabs-extension @diplodoc/latex-extension @diplodoc/mermaid-extension @diplodoc/quote-link-extension @diplodoc/folding-headings-extension markdown-it@^13 highlight.js@^11.8.0 lowlight@^3 katex@^0.16.9 2>&1 | tail -15; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/ node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head -30
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor && wc -l build/docs/INDEX.md && ls build/docs/guides; sed -n 1,140p README.md
cat build/docs/INDEX.md | head -121; cat build/docs/guides/how-to-add-editor-with-create-react-app.md | head -80; ls build | head -30

sed -n 80,140p build/docs/guides/how-to-add-editor-with-create-react-app.md; grep -n -A12 '"exports"' package.json | head -40; grep -rn "styles" package.json | head; sed -n 1,80p build/esm/bundle/useMarkdownEditor.d.ts; grep -n "initial\|'change'\|ChangeEvent\|EditorMode\|change" build/esm/bundle/Editor.d.ts | head -30

ls build/esm/styles build/styles.css 2>&1 | head; sed -n 140,155p package.json; grep -n "styles" README.md build/docs -r | grep -i "import" | head; cat build/esm/bundle/editor-public-types.d.ts | head -120; grep -n "initial\|markupConfig\|wysiwygConfig\|md?\|md:" build/esm/bundle/types.d.ts | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm && sed -n 20,60p bundle/types.d.ts; grep -n "MarkdownEditorInitialOptions" -A 25 bundle/types.d.ts | head -50; sed -n 1,60p bundle/events.d.ts; grep -n "interface MarkdownEditorViewProps" -A 40 bundle/MarkdownEditorView.d.ts; head -c 600 styles/styles.css; grep -n "@import\|import" styles/styles.css | head

grep -rl "import.*\.css'" bundle/*.js | head -3; grep -n "css" bundle/MarkdownEditorView.js | head; ls ../../../../@diplodoc/transform/dist/css 2>/dev/null; cat bundle/MarkdownEditorView.d.ts | head -60

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && sed -i "s#^import '@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css';#&\nimport '@diplodoc/transform/dist/css/yfm.css';#" src/main.tsx && sed -n 1,8p src/main.tsx && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -30
rm -rf dist && git status --short | grep dist; echo ok
